provenance.procedure: candidate extractions pre-filled by the rule-based extractor; all judgments entered by the annotator after reading each conversation; no AI system assigned the audit labels
provenance.deidentified_table: results/extractor_audit_annotations_deidentified.csv (sample IDs and judgments only, no conversation text)

recall_definition: identity recall = correct / (correct + missed), where 'missed' counts both identities the extractor found nothing for (q1=missed) and identities it extracted incorrectly on non-adversarial rows (a wrong extraction also omits the correct identity). Under the previous definition (q1=missed only) identity recall was 70.8%.
